notes.title: July 2025 News [Dev Update #69]
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Just a smol update.[/p][p][/p][p]Meadow, Volcano and Desert maps are ready to go out to players.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re just fixing some of the final edge-case bugs and visual glitches from switching pipelines from HDRP to URP.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re hoping to get these out in the next 2 weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]After we release those, we have 3 other biomes we want to incorporate into maps.[/p][p][/p][p]Those will be:[/p][p]-Snow[/p][p]-Jungle[/p][p]-Marsh[/p][p][/p][p]So we’ll have 6 biomes, on top of the original maps, making 9 total (along with free roam).[/p][p][/p][p]Once those biomes are in and optimized (we don’t want to bloat your build size) we’ll be adding in unique mechanics for each area, as well as a few ways to mix up your match variety from game to game.[/p][p][/p][p]Free Roam will get expanded into a full tutorial and testing playground, and we’ll evaluate everything from there.[/p][p][/p][p]Some longer term features we’re also early in developing are Account Progression and Cloud Saves.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m thinking of making these new updates once a month on Steam, just summing up the past few weeks of info I’ve shared in the Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Will be sharing some videos soon as well![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p][p][/p][p]EDIT: Videos of the biomes are in the Discord, as well as on [url="https://www.instagram.com/riseandfallgame/"]socials here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/riseandfallgame/" style="button"]Biome Previews[/url][/p][p][/p][p]-Dave[/p]

notes.title: Pipeline Update [Dev Update #68]
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Just wanted to check in with those following on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]We've been working on some engine improvements we need to finish before we can expand and include more maps w/ unique biomes.[/p][p][/p][p]A more detailed breakdown is in our [url="https://discord.gg/4GV5uHw"]Discord![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Will keep you updated as we have things to share.[/p][p][/p][p]Sometimes, we can continue hammering out live updates quickly, and sometimes, we have more long-term groundwork we have to lay before we can add features.[/p][p][/p][p]In short TLDR, the Volcano, Desert, Meadow, Snow and Marsh biomes all are formatted for URP (a Unity Render Pipeline), whereas our game is in HDRP.[/p][p][/p][p]We switched to HDRP in 2022, since it was the best pipeline for console games at the time, and had features URP did not.  But since 2022, URP has become the default pipeline, and has the most support.[/p][p][/p][p]So a lot of things have had to be stalled or adjusted to work in HDRP.[/p][p][/p][p]After trying all kinds of conversions, we're moving the game's pipeline over to URP instead, which we would need to do anyway to ship to consoles and mobile.[/p][p][/p][p]It's almost done, the game runs, we just need to rebuild the materials and textures, and some lighting.[/p][p][/p][p]The good news--[/p][p]The game should run better! [/p][p]And we should be able to develop faster since more assets are supported in URP. [/p][p][/p][p]Talk soon![/p]

notes.title: Pricing Change! (No Longer F2P!) - Dev Update 65
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to give players a heads up about a change to [b]our prices.[/b]

For anyone who [b]already owns[/b] the game (including just having it in your library), this [b]won't affect you[/b]!

We're changing the game from Free to Play, to $2.

The game will have a [b]free demo[/b], that has all the features the game had up until the [b]2025 March[/b] Update.

Anyone who adds Rise and Fall to their library [b]before[/b] we change gets to keep their game, completely free.

So basically, no players are losing anything, but going ahead, new players who want to play the full game can pay $2 and own it all.

[u][b]Why'd We Make This Change?[/b][/u]

Lots of reasons.
-We don't have the manpower to offer enough cosmetics to do a true F2P model (at this point in time).
-We started with this model in 2019, back before Battle Passes and F2P [b]fatigue[/b] set in.
-We released the game completely free in 2020, not knowing if we'd continue working on it or what our plans would be.
-A small dev team have been working on this for over 5 years now.  Up until now, the game has been 100% free, and we've paid for everything [b]out of pocket[/b] and used our own free time to continue development.
-We see the [b]awesome reactions[/b] players give us when we take the game to showcases, and want to continue to grow the studio slowly, and in a healthy way.
-We feel good about the [b]quality[/b] and the [b]amount of content[/b] you get today for the price we're asking.
-This allows some money to come back to us, that we can re-invest into the game!
-We may increase the prices as we release more content and feel we're still offering good value for the price we ask for.
-Given our game is local co-op first, we feel this model makes more sense than most free to play games (where the bulk of the game is online and PvP).
-We wanted to start at a price point on the lower end first, then raise if needed, rather than the other way around.
-We still want the game to be affordable, feel like great quality, and a 'no-brainer' purchase.
-[b]Feedback[/b] from players at showcases were extremely positive about this being a paid game vs completely free.

And a whole lot more!

Here's a visual breakdown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/f2c46265329e65775839c67835d5fe9cb9e2b189.png[/img]

As the chart says, the main separator between the demo and the full version will be content.

Maps, modes, character customization, those are all things saved for the full version.

But we want there to be a way for people to try the game out for free, and get a feel for what the game feels like.

The demo version includes everything in the game up until March 2025.

And core features like movement, abilities etc will always also go into the demo version.

The same goes for 2v2 Quickplay, Sandbox Tuning and Balancing, and any Quality of Life updates the game may get.

We've been thinking on this for a few years now, and we feel comfortable we've found a middle ground.

-There's still a free slice of the game players can try for no cost.
-Purchasing the game with what's currently in it is a fair price (aka no charging more for a promise of content, just for what's already there!).
-Game can generate it's own income to help finance finishing the game and keep the studio and developers healthy.
-We're providing enough context on our thought process and our intents, and doing it at a time where we've recently shipped some new great features, that a portion of players get completely free.
-While we've been okay working on this game out of pocket and part time, it will be nice to offset some of that cost with money coming in from the game.


We're always interested in hearing what players think. Don't be afraid to stop by in the [url=https://discord.gg/4GV5uHw]Discord[/url] and let us know your thoughts on the March Update and the new pricing.

notes.title: Roadmap Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/848d5786e22cb4cbc9c9082dbaea0cb2c1953cf4.png[/img]
[b]Hey everyone!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/19403af49f42c92667920ab52943f75e503bbd80.png[/img]
[i]A recent photo from Toronto's Comic Con 2022 (March 18, 2022).  Cecilia (Duncan's Fiance), Duncan (Modeller/Playtester), Dave (Game Director), and Pedro (Concept Artist), from our team![/i]

It's been a few months since we formally posted, but we have been[b] updating the game[/b] [b]regularly[/b] on the [b]test branch[/b].

Most of the changes have been [b]backend work[/b] for [b]online play[/b] to work, and don't really translate well to patch notes.

The past [b]3 months[/b] or so have been Kosam and myself building our [b]networking architecture[/b] out so we can [b]run the game online[/b] like it was [b]in person[/b].

So far, it feels pretty good.  You can grab and shoot the ball while not being the host and it feels like couch co-op.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/dcf954069733bdc2d7427b3f5e034d12e4c0ee22.png[/img]
[i]Some kids really enjoying playing Rise and Fall co-op together at Comic Con 2022.  They had some great ideas for us, and even came back several times to play![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/af5d2fdb9477458ac397e1e80ad67f6a907e3b37.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/6ebbdec07f6d1b0e7fae07ff788b1f0325db15f4.png[/img]

You can go ahead and [b]play an early version[/b] of online matches on our [b]test branch[/b] right [b]now[/b]!

To switch off the [b]main branch[/b] onto our [b]test branch[/b], do this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/29b58629a7f8e772d7e2d5fa3559034109adaad4.png[/img]

-Open Steam's Library and right-click on 'Rise and Fall'
-Click Properties
-Click 'Betas'
-Select 'Test Branch'

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/af5d2fdb9477458ac397e1e80ad67f6a907e3b37.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/bb3c966f60585eb4f2b21493f68f98a91c7b1375.png[/img]

Secondly, we've got a [b]rough roadmap[/b] ready we want to share.

Timelines are [b]still flexible[/b], code always takes longer than you think it will.

Generally, our goals for the next year or so are [b]these 4 milestones.[/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/db06ca6fdebffce40c7e4a72a47023c5cc841329.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/8ffd6c28acfea4d07732bf4be83a2f93eaa247f1.png[/img]

-We continue [b]playing[/b], [b]testing[/b], and [b]polishing[/b] the [b]online play[/b] so it [b]feels good [/b]enough to play for [b]hours[/b] on end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/d85d5a8d99ffe6d382daba939e7d7650428f4405.png[/img]

The [b]backend[/b] we're using for networking is called [b][url=https://www.photonengine.com/en-US/Photon]Photon PUN 2[/url][/b].

It lets us have [b]up to 16 players[/b] in a 'room' at a time,

And it allows us to [b]scale our backend[/b] up to higher and more advanced tech.

Eventually, we can [b]upgrade our backend[/b] from Photon PUN 2-> Photon Quantum.

[url=https://www.photonengine.com/en-US/Quantum][b]Quantum[/b][/url] is [b]built[/b] for [b]e-sports[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/82cf7ada65dfa3575aefbf0be911a7eb7cbc4aad.png[/img]

It has great [b]prediction[/b] and [b]rollback netcode[/b], [b]deterministic physics[/b], allows [b]replays[/b] and [b]spectating[/b], [b]cheat protection[/b], as well as [b]server-authoritative simulation[/b].

It's a lot of big words, but what it basically means is [u]we've designed our architecture for the long haul.[/u]

A [b]fun[/b], [b]easy to get into couch co-op game[/b], that [b]anyone[/b] can jump into and [b]immediately understand[/b],
But a game that has[b] depth[/b] and [b]nuance[/b] enough to spend [b]years mastering[/b].

The networking[b] feels good enough[/b] for us to be comfortable recommending friends and players to [b]test out.[/b]

In the [b]future[/b], we'll eventually upgrade to Quantum, which will have [b]even more features[/b] for [b]even better online play[/b].

We've really been enjoying some of the awesome new features we've been adding since May 2021 (our last 'stable' build, and the one you'll see by default if you install our game).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/82fc5b935cbd936af3e48f5d6a4487bc59dfaf61.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/8a0046a6e9452d42c36b4026a165a7bea163fecb.png[/img]

Just like networking, we [b]playtest[/b] and [b]polish[/b] [b]everything[/b] in the game (that being networked and couch co-op) modes so they [b]feel amazing[/b] to play and you [b]can run for hours[/b] on end with no issues.

We are [u][b]so proud[/b][/u] of the[b] glowing feedback[/b] we've gotten from players we've gotten a chance to play with in person at [b]Eat Play Mingle, Comic Con[/b], and early in class at [b]George Brown[/b].

It's so [b]incredibly motivating[/b] to see all kinds of people's [b]faces [/b][b]light up[/b] when we hand them a controller and they start playing for the first time.

[b]It means the world to us[/b], and we're so happy to continue building this [b]special game[/b] we all love.

The build we've been showing off at in-person events is our [b]May 2021 build[/b], and also the one on our main default branch.

That's because it's the [b]most stable[/b], and we know we can run it for 20+ hours of play and not run into any issues that could interrupt you having fun.

Our 2nd Roadmap goal is to [b]take everything we've been working on in the last year[/b] and bring that out to the main branch.

Some features include:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/8b251877dfd3f057ace758a9f120a8d9753755ef.png[/img]

-Default map has been made bigger to accommodate for bigger matches and increased speed and abilities.

-Up to 16 players can play in a single match, allowing Rise and Fall to be a fun large group activity (like our Streamdays with Among Us and Scoober Splat). [Previous build was up to 4 players]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/c4941ef1cf07379feed619324a5c1c7608700d4d.png[/img]
   -[b][u]Right Stick Aiming[/u][/b]: Players can use the Right Stick to aim their shot precisely in the direction they 
    want to shoot. [No longer limited to shooting purely in the direction you're facing]

   -[b][u]Possession[/u][/b]: Players can now grab onto the ball if they choose to, and carry it with them. [Previously 
     players had to hit the ball in motion]

   -[b][u]Gliding[/u][/b]: Players can press Y to open a glider and get extra control in-air to line up shots and perform 
   trick shots. [This actually came from a glitch that froze players in the air, but it was so fun, we made it 
    a feature]

 -[b][u]Dive Momentum[/u][/b]: After diving, players have increased speed until they stop moving.  
    Can be a nice way to get a little more speed without needing to do a full size change.  
    Players can also continue to press and hold the dive button to 'boost' themselves in higher tiers of 
    speed if needed.

 -[b][u]Triple Jumps[/u][/b]: One of my favourite features from platformers, players now jump in a 3-stage 
    cycle, with each jump being slightly higher.  It also makes each jump feel unique and bouncy, and 
    we're really with it.

-[b][u]Ball Lifts and Freezes[/u][/b]: Pressing Shrink or Grow + Jump will either shoot the ball up into the air, or 
   freeze it's current momentum.  These can be chained with other players to set up for some fun lob 
   shots.

 -[b][u]Ground Pounds[/u][/b]: Pressing the Grow Button will make your player slam down onto the ground, which 
    can be a good way to quickly drop height, as well as disrupt a play beneath you.

 -[b][u]3rd Person Camera[/u][/b]: Players playing in modes that aren't couch co-op (like online) can press in 
   the right stick to swap to a special 3rd person camera.  Lets you focus more on your individual play if

[h3][u][b]Match Setup:[/b][/u][/h3]

-Players can set up [b]custom matches[/b] before they enter a game in a [b]new match setup scree[/b]n.
[u][b]Players can choose:[/b][/u]
   a) What [b]team[/b] they play for, 
   b) What[b] character model[/b] to use
   c) What [b]colour their UI[/b] should be
   d) A [b]nickname[/b] for their player
   e) Whether that player should be [b]human[/b] or [b]AI[/b]
   f) If that player is AI, [b]how difficult[/b] they should be.

-Players can then choose to play [b]with or without goalies[/b], and [b]add or remove[/b] certain [b]stage hazards[/b], before[b] choosing a map[/b] to play on.

This was a [u][b]HUGE[/b][/u] undertaking, and once again, huge props to our Lead Programmer [b]Kosam[/b] for [b]re-writing our backen[/b]d to be able to accomplish this.

It basically required us to [b]re-write the entire game's code from scratch[/b] with architecture that let us build matches modularly and independent of each other.

We're [b]really excited[/b] to get this feature out to players and see the [b]different kind of matches [/b]you come up with!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/75cc528f42fc9519ea501131705ee7fb042dc419.png[/img]

-On top of expanded offline, couch co-op matches, Rise and Fall 2.0 will include [b]online matches[/b] for the first time.

-Players will click the [b]'online' button[/b] and be [b]connected[/b] to our [b]network[/b] and sent to a [b]main lobby[/b].
-Once [b]connected[/b], players can [b]create and join rooms[/b]--[b]individual instances[/b] of the arena where players can [b]hang out[/b], [b]start matches[/b] and [b]practice together[/b] over the network.

-Up to [b]16 people[/b] can join a room as of right now (with [b]bigger rooms possible[/b] in the future).

-Players can then [b]enter the arena[/b], [b]choose settings[/b] like [b]which team they want[/b] and [b]how long a match should last[/b],

Then [b]ready up[/b] and a [b]match will start[/b] when enough players are [b]ready[/b].

-To [b]start[/b], we're [b]locking rooms[/b] when matches are happening, but in [b]the future[/b], we want to [b]open rooms up[/b] for people to [b]join at any time[/b], [b]hang out[/b], [b]watch matches[/b], and [b]play in practice courts[/b].

It's kind of meant to have a [b]Destiny,[/b] [b]VR-Chat [/b]and [b]Echo VR[/b] public space vibe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/bf07f725c98bb306b1f10c704d275c75a40e05cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/6d1dd8a94224bf14d77f4dc462a6efd05ab937ee.png[/img]

The [b]architecture[/b] for this is already [b]mostly done[/b] (thanks to the [b]amazing work[/b] of Kosam).

We want to bring [b]building custom characters[/b] to [b]every part[/b] of the game.

[b][u]This means customizing: (at first)[/u][/b]
  a) your [b]character's model[/b]
  b) Your [b]skin and hair colour[/b]
  c) Your [b]clothing colour[/b]
  d) Your [b]club [/b]

You can then [b]save[/b] that character and [b]use them[/b] in [b]matches[/b] online and offline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/9c87e7821f57d7ddd78dac3ce00c581322d5bb15.png[/img]

[b]Eventually[/b], when we feel [b]confident[/b] with those features being [b]stable[/b],
We'll add [b]more cosmetics[/b] and [b]customization options[/b] as [b]free unlockables/purchases[/b].

When we're [b]confident[/b] with the [b]stability[/b] of that, we'll look at adding [b]battlepasses[/b], [b]paid cosmetics[/b], and [b]in-game earnable cosmetics[/b] through [b]challenges and achievements[/b].

When those [b]3 stages[/b] are [b]stable[/b] and we're [b]confident[/b] with them, we'll look at launching on [b]more platforms[/b].

Our game is built in [b][url=https://unity.com/]Unity[/url][/b], an engine designed to be [b]easy to port games[/b] to many platforms.
We use a special Unity asset called [b]'[url=https://guavaman.com/projects/rewired/]Rewired[/url]'[/b] for handling player input.

This means that the [b]backend[/b] of our game was designed from the [b]beginning[/b] to be brought to [b]more platforms[/b]!

[b]For example[/b], our backend with Rewired, [b]automatically recognizes[/b][b] over 100 different controllers[/b] and assigns inputs to them based on a template we choose.

If there's a [b]small mistake[/b] (like input is reversed for some reason), it's a [b]quick[/b] button mapping fix.

[b]Our plan[/b] is to get our game out on [b]as many platforms as possible[/b] (including mobile, Rewired makes input mapping for that simple!).

There are also cloud backends (like Unity cloud build) that automatically push builds to multiple platforms every time you make a change, that should make this streamlined.

notes.title: [BETA BRANCH] Charged Swing Buffs
notes.content:
Hey guys!

A lot of small changes that add up over a while.

This is actually a build from July 26th, there's more changes we just don't have stable yet and can't release yet.

This one really brings the charged swing into its' own as the power shot we wanted it to be.

We've been quiet for a little bit just because we've really gotten into a rhythm with lockdown ending and things opening up in Canada here.

Our plan to get more updates out quicker is to simplify our pipeline getting changes to you.

Most likely, we'll go with a model like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/ac70815d8dfb6133ec5c0fcdaa36a1cb2beaf167.png[/img]

Test - Has the latest features, tweaks, and changes, but is the least stable.

Stable - A little behind test, but more stable.

Main - The default version of the game that goes out to everyone.  Most stable.

That'll at least allow us to be pushing things publicly faster and time between updates quicker.

It'll mean an update has a few changes from the week, sent to test, which will also speed things up as the patch notes aren't a month's worth of changes.

Anyways, here's the changes!


[h1][u][b]PLAYERS
[/b][/u][/h1]

[u][b]Models:[/b][/u]
-P3's club size matches other players, and fits his hand properly
-P3's large size head arrow fits their head properly.
-Made P2 and P4's character skin consistent between their player sizes.
-Fixed the Red Goalie's helmet from being parented wrong in the medium size.

[u][b]Tuning:[/b][/u]
-Players P2, P3, and P4 have the stronger dive that P1 has.
-Players P2, P3, and P4 have the same jump arch as P1.
-Charged Swing has been given more force and it's range is slightly bigger
//This makes the charged swing feel more in line what we wanted it to be, a part of the regular game loop where you weight between getting a quick hit off or aiming a stronger one with more force.
-Charged Swing now activates within a 1/2 second of holding the button, instead of 1 full second, which felt too long.
-Large size's jump has been buffed slightly.
//Meant to be enough that you can use it in some situations, but it's still better to change sizes for more than a little bit of height. You can now jump up onto the corner 'arms' as large.
-Fixed P2's running and aiming from being slightly off by a few degrees.
-Made goalies slightly heavier and harder to move.
-Made the charged swing less strong on hitting players back
//Was accidentally the same as the large size.

[u][b]Colliders:[/b][/u]
-Small, Medium and Large sized players have a slightly wider collider, better representing their actual size.
-All player's clubs now have a uniform collider over them (capsule shape).
//Means the ball won't clip through them and your club can block a shot.

[u][b]Effects:[/b][/u]
-Added a charge effect to the charged swing when you hold the button down.
-Added a better effect for charging up a swing
-Fixed the small run footstep from appearing when the player is in the air.
-Charged Swing's release feels more powerful by adding 5x the slash effects
//Also gives a better visual of the swing's range.
-Made the large player's swing slightly easier to see by adding 2 more slash effects above and below.
-Added small camera shake on release of the charged swing.

[u][b]Animations:[/b][/u]
-Fixed the charged swing animation from sticking sometimes.

[u][b]Audio:[/b][/u]
-Charged swing's audio plays quicker and the charge up sound is quieter.
-Charged Swing has a woosh sound play that makes it feel heavier than normal attacks.
-Large player swings have a slightly heavier swing sound.
-Lowered the pitch on the charged swing to make it sound heavier.
-Fixed a ball impact sound from not playing when a human player hit the ball.

[u][b]UI:[/b][/u]
-Changed the floor circle below a player to stay on the ground, so you can tell where you are in the air.
-P4's UI is now purple, making it easier to see on a green floor.


[h1][u][b]GOALIES
[/b][/u][/h1]

-Fixed CPU Goalies from not working.
-Activating CPU goalies doesn't make your cursor invisible anymore.
-Fixed Blue CPU Goalie's Head Arrow from being too high above his head.

[h1][u][b]BALL
[/b][/u][/h1]

-Removed an inactive light that wasn't being used, but still drew CPU power

[u][b]Effects:[/b][/u]
-Added squash and stretch to the ball when it's hit, making it feel bouncier.
-Gave the ball a reticle on the ground, always showing where it is in the air.
-Ball has a shadow underneath that changes based on it's height.

[u][b]Audio:[/b][/u]
-Glass and rocks now play 1 of 10 impact effect sounds, the same way they do with the ground.
//Makes the ball movement feel more fluid, don't hear the same 1 sound repeat over and over.

[h1][u][b]CAMERA
[/b][/u][/h1]

-Camera now cuts to a specific goal camera when goals are scored, and then back.

[h1][u][b]UI
[/b][/u][/h1]

[h1][u][b]CLIFF LEVEL
[/b][/u][/h1]

-Gave the red goalie a capsule collider on his club.

notes.title: [BETA-Branch] Update 1.3: Graphics and Cliff Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

For this month's update, the game will look a little different.

That's because we've upgrade the version of Unity we build the game in, as well as upgraded the graphics pipeline to HDRP.

This means better graphics, lighting, performance, we have better tools we can use to make the game.

We've also overhauled a ton of our systems, scripts, and inspectors to make the game run better and quicker to update and change.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/cd662feeea1501a67c2896817b7fa756ee8056e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/e9f144db92da9f1b24a6bad4a0e9a6e59f68454a.png[/img][/url]

For example, we've gone and written custom inspectors with Odin (a plugin for Unity), so we can quickly visualize and tweak all sorts of things on the fly in the editor.

This means we make mistakes less often, and find mistakes quicker.  It make it easier on the programming team to find bugs, easier for myself to test all kinds of gameplay variations, and in general, making working on the game way more fun to do.

If you're a game dev, I highly recommend doing this.

We also moved our entire folder structure to 'object-based' from 'type-based'.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/d831f1bc2a1eabe96e5fe4878bb2a3f8f7c67e16.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/ad9d2163ee8a32dcfc4e48bf7c963ba85fbfd88a.png[/img][/url]

That means that everything is organized based on what the object does.

So everything related to the Cannon in grouped together in the same folder.

Which just makes our lives so much easier.  Highly recommend for bigger projects.

Makes it so easy to break down what's effecting what, and quickly make changes knowing we're not breaking something else.

We also brought in Peek by Ludiq, which DEAR LORD is a god-send for myself if you want to tweak levels quickly.  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/b529b705f510bab9d3768b6c193bcb71129c0068.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37944793/66146dd41d3a57d079b302d29316c6c47a9c9f72.png[/img][/url]

It basically lets you work full screen, and clicking any object in the scene opens things up contextually.

I can't go back, it just makes using Unity so much more intuitive and makes everything faster to do.

Unity, buy this plugin ASAP!

As for game updates, I'll write everything down here, as I go through the Commit History.

I'll try to get everything in here.

[b][u][h2] ENGINE [/h2][/u][/b]

[b][h3] UNITY VERSION [/h3][/b]

-Upgraded project to Unity 2019 LTS.  
//A much more stable version of Unity, made for long-term development, with more features.

[b][h3] RENDER PIPELINE [/h3][/b]

-Now using the High-Definition Render Pipeline, designed for console games, with a year of new features, stability and performance boosts.
-Allows for better lighting in real time and better shadows.
-Skybox looks better
-Scene draws light from skybox itself.
-Fog is dynamic and not a flat effect
-Decal support to project objects onto other objects with little performance drops.
-Better control for materials and textures
-Volumetric Lighting

[b][h3]APPLICATION ICON[/h3][/b]

-Application now uses the new Rise and Fall 'crest' icon.

-Application icon scales properly on different sizes.

[b][u][h2]CONTROLLERS[/h2][/u][/b]

-Stadia controller support.  Buttons and UI will now work properly.

[u][h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2][/u]

-Charged swing uses the proper-sized collider on small, medium and large.
//Was accidentally using a tiny collider, making using the swing almost impossible.

[b][u][h2]PLAYERS
[/h2][/u][/b]

-CPU Goalies now have helmets, making them look different from regular players.

-Air control when diving is fixed and back to normal.

-Players now have a shadow underneath them at all times, as well as their normal shadow.
//Makes it easier to judge height in the air, working to merge these two together.

[b][h3]SMALL[/h3][/b]

-Small size jump is now longer and more floaty.

-Running as the small size now has footstep sounds and your steps kickup dust.



[b][u][h2]GEOMETRY
[/h2][/u][/b]

[b][h3]GENERAL[/h3][/b]

-Fixed spots where players could get stuck in as the small size, which could get annoying given the new camera system.

-Added support beams around the arena to make it 'feel' more structurally sound and supported in the air. 

-Added mountains in the background with a route to the stadium.
-A path wraps around both mountains towards the stadium.

-Rocks now use the same texture on all models, making it look better, and allowing us to make quick changes on the fly.
//Ever want a team colour that's different than red and blue? That's what we're building this towards.

-Removed some objects in the scene that were no longer used or needed.

[b][h3]CANNON[/h3][/b]

-Cannon now uses a new model that looks more like a cannon.
-Cannon firing effect is on end of muzzle.
-Lowered cannon's delay at the end of it rotating to 0.75 seconds from 1 second.
//Felt it was a little TOO easy to time this, instead of a little more risk and reward like we intended.

-Cannon's trigger volume (the sphere around it that pulls the ball in) slightly bigger to prevent the ball accidentally hitting the cannon and bouncing out.
//Also just felt better.

-Improved firing effect.
-Cannon has legs.
-Cannon has a ball decal on it to show the player what it's used for.

-Cannon uses new physics system in Unity 2019.4

-Cannon has a firing animation where the barrell recoils.

[b][h3]BALL[/h3][/b]

-Ball feels like normal again.
//We tried writing a fix for the ball temporarily stopping spinning when it's shot out of the cannon, but it broke the bounciness of the ball.
//It's been reverted. Still looking for a fix on it not rotating right away.

-Ball has real-time shadow and a fixed shadow showing it's position in the air.

-Ball reacts to hitting glass by lighting the glass up temporarily.

-Ball has a yellow glow around it, that directly matches the distance you need to be from it to hit it.
//If you're inside the glow, you will hit it.

-The circle around the ball UI is now sized to match this distance.

[b][h3]BUMPERS[/h3][/b]

-Fixed a spot where a bumper may not have acted like a bumper and bounced balls properly.

[b][h3]WALL CHEESE [/h3][/b]

-Wall cheese now have X's on them to show you shouldn't shoot at them.

-Wall cheese is now handled through code, and can be tweaked on the spot if needed.

-Wall cheese stays a little longer to give players more time to get set.

[b][h3]WATER[/h3][/b]

-Water is a new shader built for HDRP, that moves more dynamically and reflects light better.

[b][h3]GLASS[/h3][/b]

-Glass now has a hexagonal pattern running across it.
-Added a transparent finish to the bottom so you can see where the arena boundaries are better, but can still see through it.

[b][h3]LAUNCHER[/h3][/b]

[b][h3]GOAL POSTS[/h3][/b]

Both the red and blue goalposts now have a nice real-time light emitting from them.

[b][h3]CLUBS[/h3][/b]

-Clubs now have a more detailed wood material on them, giving them some definition.

[b][h3]RAMPS[/h3][/b]

-Ramps are now built and modelled and will be implemented soon.

[b][h3]GROUND[/h3][/b]

-Added the Rise and Fall 'crest' logo to the middle of the arena.

-Ground is now grass, instead of dirt.

-Chalk is now projected onto grass and not it's own object, looking better.

[b][h3]LIGHTING[/h3][/b]

-Now uses HDRP Lighting, with more options and control, and better performance.
-UV Overlaps are fixed, improving performance.
-Lights are now placed in corners of the goal glass, giving you a sense where the boundaries are without making the glass opaque.




[b][u][h2]AI[/h2][/u][/b]

-AI will not run inside the nets after a goal.

-AI will not walk into a weird position when the game starts.

-Offscreen markers disable themselves when that player is not active.

-Fixed some timescale bugs with diving.

-Stopped AI from sometimes spamming their DiveFX over and over.

-Stopped things from happening to characters while in pause menu.

-Players will no longer recieve input when the game is paused.


[b][u][h2]UI[/h2][/u][/b]

-Added Off-screen makers for players when they go off screen.
//You'll see a coloured arrow following you, so you know how to get back into the frame.

-Built a Rise and Fall 'Crest' logo: The two clubs and ball on a shield.
//This will be used as the game's 'main' logo in situations where writing the text out doesn't make as much sense.

-Fixed 'Last 15 Seconds' UI appearing above the Timer UI.
-Fixed the audio not being controlled by the audio settings.

-Re-organized hierarchy so the Pause Menu will always appear above any in-game UI.

[b][h3]GOAL SCORING[/h3][/b]

-Goal lights now fade in and out and last longer.

[b][h3]Victory Screens[/h3][/b]

-Victory effects like confetti and fireworks have been updated to fit the larger map.

[b][u][h2]AUDIO[/h2][/u][/b]

-An entire audio pass has been done on everything in the game, meaning there's less highs and lows of sounds.
//Audio is more comfortable to listen to.

Swing:
-Club audio was weirdly playing from far in the distance, so we've moved it back to the club itself.

Charged Swing:
-Disabled an extra sound in the charged swing that wasn't supposed to play.

Ball:
-The fuse is slightly quieter.

[b][h3]CLUBS[/h3][/b]

-Hitting a post with your club makes a satisfying 'ding' sound.

-Hitting rocks with your club makes an impact effect and a sound.

-Club hitting sound has been brought down to be less loud.

-Hitting the cannon with your club will make an effect and a sound.

[b][h3]LAUNCHER[/h3]
[/b]
-Launcher's audio is normalized and more consistent.

[b][u][h2]CURRENTLY FIXING[/h2][/u][/b]

-Lighting on the glass panels isn't lighting up as expected.

-The launchers' treadmills are animating the speed they're supposed to be.


[b][u][h2]CLOSING[/h2][/u][/b]

We've pushed this all to beta branch, which you can go and play right now.

We'll eventually push this to the main branch once we've added a few features and fixed a few small things.

Thanks guys!

-Dave

[u][b]1) Loading Time Fix[/b][/u]
- Massively sped up the loading times loading into a match.
- Matches only take a few seconds to load into.
- The first time you load your first match after updating, the load time will be slightly longer (but still shorter than before).  
- Afterwards, loading is only a few seconds.

2) "Anti-Cheese" Implemented
- Added Guard Rails on the table that spawn in when a goal is scored.
- This prevents "cheesing" goals by hitting the ball into an open net once it spawns.
- The guard rails are angled so the ball will go over the net if hit right away.


[u][b]In Progress:[/b][/u]

[b]"Anti Cheese"[/b]
- Add some animation/effects/sound to make the anti-cheese feel more natural in-game
- Make it toggleable on/off in settings

To follow what we're working on, check out our Trello!
[url=https://trello.com/b/jAJERNTs/rise-and-fall-game-jam-3]https://trello.com/b/jAJERNTs/rise-and-fall-game-jam-3[/url]

Also feel free to let us know what you think via our forums or Discord server!

We're a small team of recent graduates and current students at George Brown, so we're doing our best to update the game as often as we can!

Thanks!

Dave

notes.title: Player Difficulty Settings!
notes.content:
A couple small updates.

1) Player Difficulty Settings
[list]
[*] Players can now turn AI Difficulty up in the settings menu.
[*] There's 3 options: Easy, Normal and Hard.
[*] Upping their difficulty will make players move faster for a challenge.
[/list]

2) Players can be manually turned on or off
[list]
[*] In the same menu, you can manually turn players on or off.
[*] Play a 1v1, or practice by yourself if you want to.
[/list]

3) AI Adjustments
[list]
[*] AI now jump more often than before.
[/list]

4) Keyboard Bindings
[list]
[*] Pressing Enter now also swings the club for P1.
[/list]


5) Knockback Adjustments
[list]
[*] Reeled in player knockback by a tiny percent.
[/list]


6) Announcer Implemented
[list]
[*] Our new announcer for the game has been implemented, and will call out goals being scored.
[*] More to come from him soon!
[/list]

7) Under the hood changes for new features coming soon
[list]
[*] We're working on some [b]level variants[/b] for the map.
[*] Scripting for[b] conveyor belts, moving platforms and boost pads[/b] are in the game and being worked on.
[/list]
